instruction: Applicants register a mobile number, verify it with a code and set a password.
Applicants select online transfer verification and accept the client agreements to start the application.
Applicants select their place of residence and provide ID, contact details and proof of address.
Applicants provide employment, financial, investment and tax details, review risk disclosures and verify their phone by SMS.
Applicants check and sign the application electronically. The transfer instructions appear once the details are submitted.
The Hong Kong dollar route uses a Hong Kong bank account held solely in the applicant’s name.
Futu uses an FPS transfer of at least HK$10,000 from the linked bank account for verification.
Applicants enter the transfer amount in Futubull and submit the deposit request.
After the transfer and notification, Futu reviews the application within 1–2 working days and sends updates by app message and email.
Applicants start from Open Account on Webull’s main screen.
Applicants upload their chosen ID. Non-permanent Hong Kong residents also need a second ID.
Applicants enter personal and address details. The address proof must match and be dated within three months.
Applicants provide employment and financial details and choose the account type and investment objectives.
For online verification by FPS, applicants transfer HK$10,000 in HKD from a bank account in their own name.
Webull requires a deposit notification in the app with the amount and a receipt.
Applicants submit after verification. Opening usually takes 1–2 business days, with confirmation by app or email.
